articles.title: Bajaj Finance issues 5.74 crore warrants to promoter for Rs 5,799 crore
articles.excerpt:
Bajaj Finance has allotted 5.74 crore warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv, for Rs 5,799 crore. The special committee of the board approved the issue at an issue price of Rs 1,010 per warrant. Each warrant is convertible into an equivalent number of equity shares of the company. A minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable at allotment, while the remaining 75 percent will be payable later.

articles.title: Mutual funds' Nifty 50 allocation falls to 21-year low
articles.excerpt:
Domestic mutual funds’ allocation to Nifty 50 stocks fell to a 21-year low in the September quarter, slipping below 50 per cent for the first time in over two decades, as fund portfolios continued to expand beyond the country’s largest benchmark companies.

The share of Nifty 50 stocks in mutual funds’ holdings of NSE-listed equities declined by two percentage points to 49.4 per cent from 51.4 per cent in June, according to the National Stock Exchange’s (NSE) India Ownership Tracker report. This was 13.5 percentage points below the December 2019 peak of 63 per cent.
